code.title: Three versions
src: Net Sales Big = SUMX ( FactSalesBig, FactSalesBig[Quantity] * FactSalesBig[UnitPrice] * ( 1 - FactSalesBig[Discount] ) )
-- 1: iterates every fact row and calls the measure per row (context transition each time)
Customers Over 500 Slow = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( FactSalesBig, [Net Sales Big] > 500 ) )
Customers Over 500 = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( DimCustomer[CustomerKey] ), [Net Sales Big] > 500 ) )
-- 3: iterates the distinct customer keys present in the fact
Customers Over 500 v3 = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( SUMMARIZE ( FactSalesBig, FactSalesBig[CustomerKey] ), [Net Sales Big] > 500 ) )

code.title: Query to time in DAX Studio

a-perf-1.check: Version 1 shows far more storage engine queries and/or CallbackDataID. Version 2 is a handful of SE queries.
a-perf-1.note: Version 1 is not only slow, it answers a different question: it counts fact rows over 500, not customers. Fast and wrong is still wrong, so always check the number first.

Table → Incremental refresh: Archive 2 years, Incrementally refresh 3 days, optionally Detect data changes (ModifiedDate) and Only refresh complete days.
Publish → Refresh once. SSMS → connect to powerbi://api.powerbi.com/v1.0/myorg/<workspace> → table → Partitions.
Insert a row dated 10 days ago → refresh → it doesn't appear. Widen the incremental window → refresh → it appears.
a-perf-3.check: Partitions: whole years for old data, then quarters, months, and days for the most recent period.
a-perf-3.note: The first refresh after publishing loads the whole archive. Plan it outside business hours.

code.title: Two ways to compute session length
src: DATEDIFF ( CALCULATE ( MIN ( WebEvents[EventTime] ) ), CALCULATE ( MAX ( WebEvents[EventTime] ) ), MINUTE )
SessionStart = MINX ( FILTER ( WebEvents, WebEvents[SessionID] = EARLIER ( WebEvents[SessionID] ) ), WebEvents[EventTime] )
SessionEnd   = MAXX ( FILTER ( WebEvents, WebEvents[SessionID] = EARLIER ( WebEvents[SessionID] ) ), WebEvents[EventTime] )
AVERAGEX ( VALUES ( WebEvents[SessionID] ), DATEDIFF ( MIN ( WebEvents[SessionStart] ), MIN ( WebEvents[SessionEnd] ), MINUTE ) )

a-perf-4.check: Sessions 39 · Sessions With Purchase 6 · Conversion Rate 15.4% · Avg Session Minutes 8.18.
a-perf-4.note: In (b), CALCULATE(MIN(...), ALLEXCEPT(WebEvents, WebEvents[SessionID])) is a clearer modern alternative to EARLIER.
